params.body: Flat painted tones, lightest to darkest by the darkness thresholds, then the lace and its core layered over them with Lerp.
params.title: Body and lace

params.body: The stamp count plus a slow noise, thinned out by the sun. Each AA Step threshold moves to the next, darker tone.
params.title: Darkness

params.body: The open water between rosettes and the creases where they touch, as crisp masks. The lace breathes with the refraction focus, widens under the sun and gets bitten by stamps.
params.title: Lace

params.body: The light angle, in degrees, as a direction, and the direction across it.
params.title: Light direction

params.body: The mesh UV in pond units, +y toward the bottom like the reference. p is the pattern space every layer reads.
params.title: Pond space

params.body: Two noise reads scroll at their own speed and angle. Together they give one offset that bends every layer the same way, so the whole pattern sways like water. Their sum is the focus that makes the lace breathe.
params.title: Refraction

params.body: Voronoi F1 grows a round disc around each cell center; a finer Voronoi scallops the rim with bumps. Where two rosettes touch, the cell edge (F2 − F1) cuts a thin crease. depth is how far inside a rosette a point lies.
params.title: Rosettes

params.body: Three more Voronoi reads, at other scales and two of them rotated, cut into round dabs with AA Step. Their count, only inside the rosettes, darkens the water.
params.title: Stamps

params.body: A long band of light: a sharp Gaussian core (Exp of −x²) plus a wide soft glow across the light direction, strongest where it enters and fading along it. A slight left-to-right gradient keeps the shade from going flat.
params.title: Sun band

params.body: Each tone blends its shade, mid and sun colors by the light. Select takes the shade-to-mid blend below the mid light (0.3) and the mid-to-sun blend above it.
params.title: Tones

params.body: The pond deepens and darkens toward the edges of the view, in screen space.
params.title: Vignette
